scientific_integrity: The infinite theorem follows from the analytic cumulant/Poisson conditioning proof. Finite exhaustive tests are only corroboration. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed 0<lambda<1 only; no convergence rates or critical-regime law. Separate marginal CLTs and finite multivariate enumeration were previously known. Historical priority of the full joint asymptotic statement is not independently established.
title: Joint Gaussian fluctuations of sources, sinks, and isolated vertices under subcritical acyclicity conditioning
